entities.name: Jakub Škarek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jakub Škarek is a Czech professional ice hockey goaltender for the San Jose Barracuda in the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected 72nd overall by the New York Islanders in the 2018 NHL Entry Draft.
